title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
director: Jun Fukuda, Yoshimitsu Banno, Ishirô Honda
actors: Hiroshi Ishikawa, Yuriko Hishimi, Minoru Takashima
plot: After a manga artist and his friends uncover a plot by his employers at an amusement park to lure Ghidorah and Gigan to Earth, Godzilla and Anguirus set out to aid in defeating the alien invaders.
